svg.text: 111 ChestX-Det test films · the app benchmark's reads, same prompt and parser for both models
same test set for every model · % (higher is better)

Amber = radiologist (dashed on the model panels for reference) · slate = MedGemma 27B box · blue = Skanda outline and box. Abnormal case: the one with Skanda's highest box overlap; normal case: random (seed 0) among normals Skanda cleared.
